title: orchestrator · Assign the research manager one bounded source-discovery cycle on memo
summary: Assign the research manager one bounded source-discovery cycle on memory benchmarks that test retention and revision rather than transcript retrieval.
body: The handoff identifies this as the next dispatch. It is a useful narrow slice of the broader question because benchmark design determines whether later comparisons measure durable, correctable memory or simply access to more past context. The manager should choose a feasible scope and stopping rule, inspect sources without running code, and report checked links plus what was actually read.
